criteria: Quotes 24 places, 36 places and the effective date 15 October, attributing the values to the initial and amended records.
The supplied log first records 24 places; the amendment sets 36 places from 15 October. This is an effective-date change, not proof that the earlier entry was simply false.

The applicable capacity for the undated observation is unresolved: A workshop attendance image is undated. Establish its event date and the rule version in force then. Do not assign either 24 or 36 places merely from the photograph or assume a year the record does not supply.

claims: A fictional permit log initially records 120 seats for a hall.
A later entry explicitly amends the permitted capacity to 90 seats from 1 July.
An attendance photograph has no reliable date.
